clue.text: Plant peeling well beyond reason

indicators.note: beyond places the peeled word after the synonym for reason

parts.note: grounds are the reason or basis for something

indicators.note: peeling strips the outer skin, so the word well loses its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A plant that has gone well past all sense, as if a gardener were losing patience.
explanation.definitionFit: Groundsel is a common weed of the daisy family, an example of a plant.

clue.text: Spirit in wind last seen in tornado

parts.note: a gust is a sudden blast of wind

indicators.note: the last letter seen in the word tornado is the one taken

explanation.surface: A weather report: some spirit in the wind, last spotted in a twister.
explanation.definitionFit: Gusto is energetic enthusiasm, a synonym of spirit in the sense of verve.

clue.text: Space where introduction missing in diary — about to write in

indicators.note: about means the shortened diary word goes around the writing phrase
the diary word loses its introduction, meaning its first letter

parts.note: a log is a diary or record kept day by day
to pen in is to write something in

explanation.surface: Looking for a free slot in a diary that lacks its first pages, ready to write something in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'introduction missing' turns LOG into OG, and 'about' puts PEN IN inside it: O-PENIN-G.
explanation.definitionFit: An opening is a gap or space, as in a gap in a hedge or a free slot.

clue.text: Northern Italian king embracing wife as right-hand man?

indicators.note: embracing means the king's name holds the wife's letter inside it

parts.note: Umberto was the name of two kings of Italy
W is the abbreviation for wife in genealogies

explanation.surface: A northern Italian monarch with his arm round his wife, taken for his deputy.
explanation.definitionFit: A number two is a deputy or second-in-command, and the question mark flags right-hand man as a figurative phrase.

clue.text: Taste garlic when cooking, as planned

indicators.note: cooking means the letters of taste and garlic are worked over into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A recipe step: taste the garlic as you cook, just as planned.
explanation.definitionFit: Strategical is an adjective meaning done according to a strategy, so deliberately planned.

clue.text: Part of a tree cut in field

indicators.note: cut means the tree part is docked of its final letter

parts.note: a leaf is part of a tree

explanation.surface: A bit of a felled tree lying in a field.
explanation.definitionFit: A lea is a poetic or old word for a meadow or open grassland.

clue.text: America east of a soggy place, it's assumed

indicators.note: in an across clue east of means placed to the right, after the marsh word

parts.note: a bog is a wet, marshy place
US is short for the United States of America

explanation.surface: A geography note: America lies east of some swamp, or so people assume.
explanation.definitionFit: Bogus means false or fake, as an assumed name is a false one.

clue.text: Wash nocturnal mammal, male

parts.note: a bat is a mammal active at night
he is the male pronoun

explanation.surface: An instruction to give a male bat a wash.
explanation.definitionFit: To bathe is to wash, especially by immersing in water.

clue.text: Broad stick to carry near rioting

indicators.note: to carry means the stick word holds the scrambled letters inside

parts.note: to gel is to set or stick together

indicators.note: rioting means the letters of near run wild into a new order

explanation.surface: A broad stick for carrying near a riot, like a police baton.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stick' reads as a noun, a baton, but it is the verb meaning to set firm; 'rioting' is the anagram signal and 'to carry' the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: General means broad or wide-ranging, as in a general overview.

clue.text: Most brief interviews initially filed in check after check

indicators.note: after means the first check comes after the second one

parts.note: to scan something is to check it

indicators.note: filed in means the letter is placed inside the first check word

parts.note: a test is a check

indicators.note: initially picks out the first letter of interviews

explanation.surface: The shortest interviews, put on file after one check after another.
explanation.definitionFit: Scantiest is the superlative of scanty, meaning very small or brief.

clue.text: Little time in a quickie that's designed to give you the vapours?

definitions.text: designed to give you the vapours?

indicators.note: in places the time letter inside the bowler

parts.note: a seamer is a fast bowler in cricket, nicknamed a quickie
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A short time in a quick fling meant to make someone swoon.
explanation.walkthrough: A seamer is a cricket bowler who moves the ball off the seam; fast bowlers are called quickies.
explanation.definitionFit: A steamer produces steam, or vapour, and the vapours is also an old term for a fit of faintness.

clue.text: An amount of money to be discussed, one feels

parts.note: a tenner is a ten-pound note

clue.text: Source of oak tree, say

parts.note: a pine is a tree

explanation.surface: Where an oak comes from, a tree, so to speak.
explanation.definitionFit: To opine is to state an opinion, a synonym of say.

clue.text: Classified as a class A drug, criminal protects pockets!

indicators.note: pockets means the scrambled word holds the drug letter inside it
criminal means the letters of protects are bent into a new order

parts.note: E is short for ecstasy, a class A drug in the UK

explanation.surface: A criminal hides class A drugs in his pockets, and the case is classified.
explanation.definitionFit: Top-secret describes classified information at the highest security level.

clue.text: A great thinker, hope Polish revolutionary overcomes Russian leader

revolutionary means the letters of hope Polish are overturned into a new order
the leader of Russian is its first letter

clue.text: Fat cat rolled over

parts.note: a gib is a tomcat, especially a castrated one

clue.text: Second right taken in course, to retrace one's steps

indicators.note: taken in means the right letter goes inside the course word

parts.note: a tack is a course, especially a sailing one

explanation.definitionFit: To backtrack is to go back along the route already taken.

clue.text: A leg in a stew with a little Italian food

explanation.surface: A recipe: a leg of meat stewed with a little Italian food on the side.

clue.text: Dismantle a bird, pigeon's head in pie

indicators.note: in means these letters go inside the pie word

parts.note: a tart is a pie
the kea is a New Zealand parrot

indicators.note: head picks the first letter of pigeon

clue.text: Having a screw loose, notice a device on a Swiss wall?

definitions.text: a device on a Swiss wall?

clue.text: Sacrifice outstanding old politician as waste material

clue.text: Kitchen vessel in sink

definitions.meaning: in snooker, to sink a ball into a pocket

explanation.surface: A cooking vessel left in the kitchen sink.

clue.text: One verifying the origin of bizarre maxim

clue.text: Fruit mother has to cultivate, also's picked?

indicators.note: has means the also word holds the other letters inside it

parts.note: too means also
ma is a familiar word for mother
to till is to cultivate soil

explanation.definitionFit: A tomatillo is a small green fruit of the nightshade family used in Mexican cooking.

clue.text: Moth-eaten spud, say?

indicators.note: say means the potato word is spoken, matching another word's sound

parts.note: tattie is a Scottish word for a potato, or spud

clue.text: Coral island, where a number lost

parts.note: a toll is the number of people killed, as in a death toll

explanation.surface: An island where some number went missing.
explanation.definitionFit: An atoll is a ring-shaped coral reef or island enclosing a lagoon.

clue.text: Free love in forfeit

indicators.note: in puts the love letter inside the forfeit word

parts.note: to lose something is to forfeit it
O is love, a zero score in tennis

explanation.surface: Love that is free once it has been forfeited.
explanation.definitionFit: Loose means unrestrained or set free, as in turned loose.

clue.text: Preacher, a person of virtue in John Paul II, say?

parts.note: Pope John Paul II was Polish, so an example of a Pole
ST is short for saint, a person of great virtue

clue.text: Down in hole, a tarantula

indicators.note: in signals the letters sit inside the words hole, a tarantula

clue.text: Endless bliss before setter leaves home — that's forcible ejection!

indicators.note: before places the shortened bliss word ahead of the rest
endless means the bliss word drops its final letter

parts.note: heaven is a state of bliss

indicators.note: leaves means the setter's pronoun departs from the word home

parts.note: home taken as written
the setter refers to themself as me

clue.text: Squatter taken to litter in pool

definitions.meaning: a cat, which crouches over a litter tray

clue.text: Engines reversed on this vessel during battle at sea

indicators.note: during places the vessel inside the jumbled letters
at sea means confused, so the letters of battle are jumbled

parts.note: an urn is a vessel

explanation.surface: Ships' engines thrown into reverse in the middle of a naval battle.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition describes a railway device: locomotives are driven onto it and turned round, so 'Engines reversed' is about trains, not ships.
